title: Tenant-facing scheduled compliance digests with presigned export delivery
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a tenant-configurable scheduled export mechanism that compiles compliance digests (PDF + CSV) containing evidence slices and delivery manifests, signs them, and sends them to tenant destinations using short-lived presigned URLs. The feature must respect tenant data-residency and retention settings, support per-tenant export templates, and surface export status and history in the Compliance Dashboard. Exports should be streamable for large archives and support optional redaction rules and encryption-at-rest when stored in staging buckets. Delivery flows must include retry/backoff, SLA alerts, and audit log entries for every generation and download event.
acceptance_criteria: Tenants can create scheduled export subscriptions that select time window, file format (PDF, CSV), residency routing, and retention snapshot policy
Export generation honors tenant residency: data is pulled from region-bound stores or routed through region-appropriate staging buckets
Each export archive includes a signed manifest JSON and human-readable PDF summary, plus a CSV extract of records; manifests are hashed and signature verified by download tools
Presigned delivery links expire after tenant-configurable window; downloads are logged to audit trails with user/actor and ip metadata
Compliance Dashboard shows export history, last delivery status, size, SLO latency, and per-tenant cost estimate for each scheduled job
System implements exponential retry with dead-letter for failed deliveries and attaches diagnostic metadata to failed export artifacts
Retention enforcement removes exported evidence per tenant retention policy after export lifecycle completes and legal hold rules are respected
technical_notes: Use staged S3-like buckets segmented by region (eu-west-1, us-east-1) with bucket-level KMS keys to ensure residency and encryption
Exports composed using streaming ZIP writer to avoid loading whole payloads into memory; PDFs generated via Headless Chromium service running in same region as data
Presigned links provided by storage service with limited TTL; signature included in manifest (ed25519) to validate integrity
Batch generation should reuse prefix/KV cache where possible to lower tokenization cost during evidence rendering
Add a small export-worker fleet with autoscaling and routing policies tied to Dedicated capacity pools for tenants with committed throughput
Telemetry: emit export.requested, export.generated, export.delivered, export.failed, export.downloaded events to observability pipeline with tenant_id, region, size_bytes, and latency_ms
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal beta with two existing compliance customers and internal security review. Phase 2: opt-in for self-serve tenants; enable dashboard widgets and cost estimation. Phase 3: GA with console defaults and API access. Toggle behind feature flag 'scheduled_compliance_exports' and gated by tenant residency validation.
comments: 2025-02-20: PM sync — agreed to include CSV and PDF formats; PDF should contain human summary + table of critical events (deletes, access).
